input.quote: 3.1 The Company shall pay HDI thirty percent (3016) of the Net Sales in excess of Eleven Thousand Dollars ($11,000) per calendar month. "Net Sales" shall mean all revenues from the sale of Deerskin Products on the Site including shipping and handling charges, minus refunds and exchanges.
input.rationale: The Fees section imposes no minimum purchase, minimum hosting fee, guaranteed volume or take-or-pay obligation on the Company. The only recurring payment is a pure revenue share (30% of Net Sales, and then only on Net Sales above an $11,000 monthly threshold that operates in our favour), so we pay only on actual sales made through the Site; HDI separately bears all design, development and hosting costs (Section 1.2). Nothing in the Agreement caps or floors the Company's usage or order volumes. This satisfies the preferred position (no minimum commitment; fees for usage/sales only), so no redline is warranted. Two adjacent terms are noted but belong to other rules and are not flagged here: the Section 4.2 Termination Payment (a termination-payment/T4C issue, not a purchase commitment) and the Section 6.1 exclusivity covenant (EXCLUSIVITY).
